name: Blind
description: Blinds the target, causing it to wander disoriented for 1 min. Damage may interrupt the effect. Limit 1.

name: Cloak of Shadows
description: Provides a moment of magic immunity, instantly removing all harmful spell effects. The cloak lingers, causing you to resist harmful spells for 5 sec.

name: Deathmark
description: Carve a deathmark into an enemy, dealing 125 Bleed damage and restoring 80 Energy to you over 16 sec. Damage dealt to the target by your Garrote, Rupture, and Lethal Poisons is increased by 100%.\n\nEach time you apply a Lethal Poison to the target, apply it twice.

name: Evasion
description: Increases your dodge chance by 100% for 10 sec.

name: Kingsbane
description:
Release a powerful poison from your weapons and inject it into your target, dealing 60 Nature damage instantly and an additional 71 Nature damage over 14 sec. 

Each time you apply a Lethal Poison to a target affected by Kingsbane, Kingsbane damage increases by 20%, up to 1,000%.

Awards 1 combo point.

name: Thistle Tea
description: Restore 100 Energy.\n\nWhen your Energy is reduced below 30, drink a Thistle Tea.

name: Amplifying Poison
description: Coats your weapons with a Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance to poison the enemy, dealing 2 Nature damage and applying Amplifying Poison for 12 sec. Envenom can consume 10 stacks of Amplifying Poison to deal 35% increased damage. Max 20 stacks.

name: Crimson Tempest
description:
Slash all enemies within 10 yds dealing 38 damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

Copy the longest Garrote and Rupture on the enemies you hit onto up to 2 other enemies. 

Awards 1 combo point.

name: Deadly Poison
description: Coats your weapons with a Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance to poison the enemy for 27 Nature damage over 12 sec. Subsequent poison applications will instantly deal 2 Nature damage.

name: Shiv
description: Attack with your off-hand, dealing 2 Physical damage, dispelling all enrage effects and applying a concentrated form of your active Non-Lethal poison.\n\nAwards 1 combo point.

name: Tricks of the Trade
description: Redirects all threat you cause to the targeted party or raid member, beginning with your next damaging attack within the next 30 sec and lasting 6 sec.

name: Gouge
description:
Gouges the eyes of an enemy target, incapacitating for 4 sec. Damage may interrupt the effect.

Must be in front of your target.

Awards 1 combo point.

name: Atrophic Poison
description: Coats your weapons with a Non-Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy, reducing their damage by 3.0% for 10 sec.

name: Numbing Poison
description: Coats your weapons with a Non-Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy, clouding their mind and slowing their attack and casting speed by 15% for 10 sec.

name: Shroud of Concealment
description: Extend a cloak that shrouds party and raid members within 30 yards in shadows, providing stealth for 15 sec.

name: Sprint
description: Increases your movement speed by 70% for 8 sec. Usable while stealthed.

name: Crimson Vial
description: Drink an alchemical concoction that heals you for 20% of your maximum health over 4 sec.

name: Distract
description: Throws a distraction, attracting the attention of all nearby monsters for 10 seconds. Usable while stealthed.

name: Kidney Shot
description:
Finishing move that stuns the target. Lasts longer per combo point, up to 8 sec:
   1 point : 4 seconds
   2 points: 5 seconds
   3 points: 6 seconds
   4 points: 7 seconds
   5 points: 8 seconds

name: Kick
description: A quick kick that interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 6 sec.

name: Garrote
description: Garrote the enemy, causing 159 Bleed damage over 18 sec.\n\nAwards 1 combo point.

name: Stealth
description: Conceals you in the shadows until cancelled, allowing you to stalk enemies without being seen.

name: Cheap Shot
description: Stuns the target for 6 sec.\n\nAwards 1 combo point.

name: Feint
description: Performs an evasive maneuver, reducing damage taken from area-of-effect attacks by 40% for 6 sec.

name: Vanish
description: Allows you to vanish from sight, entering stealth while in combat. For the first 3 sec after vanishing, damage and harmful effects received will not break stealth. Also breaks movement impairing effects.

name: Pick Pocket
description: Pick the target's pocket.

name: Ambush
description: Ambush the target, causing 96 Physical damage.\n\nAwards 2 combo points.

name: Blade Flurry
description: $@spelldesc319606

name: Create: Crimson Vial
description:
Create a Crimson Vial to share with allies. Maximum of 3 can be carried at once. 

 Crimson Vial
Drink an alchemical concoction that heals you for 30% of your maximum health over 6 sec.

name: Crippling Poison
description: Coats your weapons with a Non-Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance to poison the enemy, slowing movement speed by 50% for 12 sec.

name: Detection
description: Focus intently on trying to detect certain creatures.

name: Envenom
description:
Finishing move that drives your poisoned blades in deep, dealing instant Nature damage and increasing your poison application chance by 30%. Damage and duration increased per combo point.

   1 point  : 13 damage, 1 sec
   2 points: 28 damage, 2 sec
   3 points: 42 damage, 3 sec
   4 points: 55 damage, 4 sec
   5 points: 70 damage, 5 sec

name: Eviscerate
description:
Finishing move that disembowels the target, causing damage per combo point.
   1 point  : 13 damage
   2 points: 26 damage
   3 points: 39 damage
   4 points: 52 damage
   5 points: 67 damage

name: Fan of Knives
description: Sprays knives at all enemies within 8 yards, dealing 37 Physical damage and applying your active poisons at their normal rate. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.\n\nAwards 1 combo point.

name: Instant Poison
description: Coats your weapons with a Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy which instantly inflicts 2 Nature damage.

name: Main Gauche
description: Your main-hand attacks have a 30% chance to trigger an attack with your off-hand that deals 0 Physical damage.

name: Mutilate
description: Instantly attacks for 41 Physical damage.\n\nAwards 1 combo point.

name: Pick Lock
description: Allows opening of locked chests and doors that require a skill level of up to 70.

name: Poisoned Knife
description: Throws a poison-coated knife, dealing 8 damage and applying your active Lethal and Non-Lethal Poisons.\n\nAwards 1 combo point.

name: Rupture
description:
Finishing move that tears open the target, dealing Bleed damage over time. Lasts longer per combo point.

   1 point  : 9 over 8 sec
   2 points: 13 over 12 sec
   3 points: 18 over 16 sec
   4 points: 22 over 20 sec
   5 points: 26 over 24 sec

name: Sap
description: Incapacitates a target not in combat for 1 min. Only works on Humanoids, Beasts, Demons, and Dragonkin. Damage will revive the target. Limit 1.

name: Single-Button Assistant
description: Casts damaging abilities for use in combat, rotating through them based on priority.\n\nThe global cooldown of abilities used through the Single-Button Assistant is 25% longer.

name: Sinister Strike
description: Viciously strike an enemy, causing 31 Physical damage.\n\nAwards 1 combo point.

name: Slice and Dice
description:
Finishing move that consumes combo points to increase attack speed by 50%. Lasts longer per combo point.
   1 point  : 12 seconds
   2 points: 18 seconds
   3 points: 24 seconds
   4 points: 30 seconds
   5 points: 36 seconds

name: Wound Poison
description: Coats your weapons with a Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance to poison the enemy, which instantly inflicts 1 Nature damage and reduces all healing received by 8% for 12 sec, stacking up to 3 times.

name: Smoke Bomb
description: Creates a cloud of thick smoke in an 8 yard radius around the Rogue for 5 sec. Enemies are unable to target into or out of the smoke cloud.

name: Dismantle
description: Disarm the enemy, preventing the use of any weapons or shield for 5 sec.

name: Death from Above
description: Finishing move that empowers your weapons with energy to perform a deadly attack.\n\nYou leap into the air and Eviscerate your target on the way back down, with such force that it has a 15% stronger effect.

name: Control is King
description: Cheap Shot grants Slice and Dice for 15 sec and Kidney Shot restores 10 Energy per combo point spent.

name: Creeping Venom
description: Your Envenom applies Creeping Venom, reducing the target's movement speed by 5% for 4 sec.  Creeping Venom is reapplied when the target moves. Max 18 stacks.

name: Dagger in the Dark
description: Each second while Stealth is active, nearby enemies within 12 yards take an additional 2% damage from you for 10 sec. Stacks up to 6 times.

name: Hemotoxin
description: Shiv also reduces the target's healing received by 30% for 8 sec.

name: Maneuverability
description: Sprint has 50% reduced cooldown and 50% reduced duration.

name: Preemptive Maneuver
description: Feint decreases your damage taken by an additional 40% while stunned and its energy cost is reduced by 30%.

name: System Shock
description: Casting Envenom with at least 5 combo points on a target afflicted by your Garrote, Rupture, and lethal poison deals 11 Nature damage, and reduces their movement speed by 90% for 2 sec.

name: Thick as Thieves
description: Tricks of the Trade now increases the friendly target's damage by 15% for 6 sec.

name: Airborne Irritant
description: Blind has 50% reduced cooldown, 70% reduced duration, and applies to all nearby enemies.

name: Alacrity
description: Haste increased by 1.5%.

name: Avulsion
description: Rupture damage increased by 20%.

name: Bait and Switch
description: Evasion reduces magical damage taken by 15%. \n\nCloak of Shadows reduces physical damage taken by 20%.

name: Blackjack
description: Enemies have 30% reduced damage and healing for 6 sec after Blind or Sap's effect on them ends.

name: Blindside
description: Ambush and Mutilate have a 15% chance to make your next Ambush free and usable without Stealth. Chance increased to 30% if the target is under 35% health.

name: Bloody Mess
description: Garrote and Rupture damage increased by 15%.

name: Canny Strikes
description: Increases Critical Strike chance by 2%.

name: Caustic Spatter
description: Envenom or Kingsbane apply Caustic Spatter for 10 sec. Limit 1.\n\nCaustic Spatter causes 20% of your Nature damage dealt to splash onto other nearby enemies, reduced beyond 5 targets.

name: Cheat Death
description: Fatal attacks instead reduce you to 7% of your maximum health. For 3 sec afterward, you take 85% reduced damage. Cannot trigger more often than once per 6 min.

name: Chosen's Revelry
description: Flipping a Fatebound Coin restores 10 health.

name: Clear the Witnesses
description: Fan of Knives damage increased by 60%.

name: Cold Blooded Killer
description: Critically striking with an attack that generates combo points increases the critical strike chance of your next finishing move by 10%.

name: Controlled Chaos
description: After flipping a Fatebound Coin that ends a streak of 4 or more, flip another that matches the same face.

name: Corrupt the Blood
description: Rupture damage increased by 20%.

name: Danger Sense
description: You have a 20% chance to partially evade any damage dealt to you, reducing the damage it deals by 20%.

name: Darkest Night
description: When you consume the final Deathstalker's Mark from a target or your target dies, gain 30 Energy and Darkest Night, causing your next Envenom cast with 5 or more combo points to critically strike, deal 35% additional damage, and apply 3 stacks of Deathstalker's Mark to the target if no other Deathstalker's Mark is active.\n\nEnvenom cast with Darkest Night does not consume a stack of active Deathstalker's Marks.

name: Dashing Scoundrel
description: Envenom's effect also increases the critical strike chance of your weapon poisons by 5%, and their critical strikes generate 1 Energy.

name: Deadened Nerves
description: Physical damage taken reduced by 5%.

name: Deadly Momentum
description: Finishing moves have a 3% chance per combo point spent to increase your chance to critically strike by 6% for 6 sec.

name: Deadly Precision
description: Increases the critical strike chance of your attacks that generate combo points by 5%.

name: Deal Fate
description: Mutilate, Ambush, and Fan of Knives generate 1 additional combo point when they trigger Seal Fate.

name: Death's Arrival
description: Grappling Hook may be used a second time within 3 sec with no cooldown, but its total cooldown is increased by 5 sec.

name: Deathstalker's Mark
description:
Garrote applies 3 stacks of Deathstalker's Mark to your target, unless Deathstalker's Mark is already active. You learn Mark for Death.

When you spend 5 or more combo points on attacks against a Marked target you consume an application of Deathstalker's Mark, dealing 54 Plague damage.


Mark for Death
Move your active Deathstalker's Mark to your target.

name: Deep Cuts
description: Your finishing moves deal 6% increased damage.

name: Deeper Stratagem
description: Gain 1 additional max combo point.\n\nYour finishing moves that consume more than 5 combo points have increased effects, and your finishing moves deal 5% increased damage.

name: Delivered Doom
description: Envenom deals 5% more damage when it consumes 5 or more combo points.

name: Destiny Defined
description: Sinister Strike has 5% increased chance to strike an additional time and grant Opportunity and your Fatebound Coins flipped have an additional 5% chance to match the same face as the last flip.

name: Doomblade
description: Mutilate deals an additional 25% Bleed damage over 8 sec.

name: Dragon-Tempered Blades
description: You may apply 1 additional Lethal and Non-Lethal Poison to your weapons, but they have 30% less application chance.

name: Echoing Reprimand
description: After consuming a supercharged combo point, your next Mutilate also strikes the target with an Echoing Reprimand dealing 41 Physical damage.

name: Edge Case
description: Activating Deathmark flips a Fatebound Coin and causes it to land on its edge, counting as both Heads and Tails.

name: Elusiveness
description: Evasion also reduces damage taken by 20%, and Feint also reduces non-area-of-effect damage taken by 20%.

name: Ethereal Cloak
description: Cloak of Shadows duration increased by 2 sec.

name: Fatal Concoction
description: Increases the damage of your weapon poisons by 20%.

name: Fate Intertwined
description: Caustic Spatter causes an additional 5% of Nature damage dealt to be dealt to affected enemies.

name: Featherfoot
description: Sprint increases movement speed by an additional 30% and has 4 sec increased duration.

name: Finish the Job
description: All damage you deal is increased by 10% while Deathmark is active.

name: Fleet Footed
description: Movement speed increased by 15%.

name: Flying Daggers
description: Fan of Knives has its radius increased to 12 yds, deals 20% more damage, and an additional 10% when striking 5 or more targets.

name: Follow the Blood
description: Fan of Knives and Crimson Tempest deal 30% additional damage while 2 or more enemies are afflicted with Rupture.

name: Forced Induction
description: Increase the bonus granted when a damaging finishing move consumes a supercharged combo point by 1.

name: Graceful Guile
description: Feint has 1 additional charge.

name: Hand of Fate
description: Flip a Fatebound Coin each time a finishing move consumes 5 or more combo points. Heads increases the damage of your attacks by 10%, lasting 15 sec or until you flip Tails. Tails deals 59 Cosmic damage to your target.\n\nFor each time the same face is flipped in a row, Heads increases damage by an additional 2% and Tails increases its damage by 10%.

name: Hunt Them Down
description: Auto-attacks against Marked targets deal an additional 3 Plague damage.

name: Implacable
description: Nothing will save your target from you. Envenom damage increased by 10%. When your Envenom bonus expires, gain 20% increased Energy generation for 5 sec. \n\nGain an additional 15% increased Energy generation for each Envenom you used while Envenom's bonus was active, up to 80% total.

name: Improved Ambush
description: Ambush generates 1 additional combo point.

name: Improved Garrote
description: Garrote deals 50% increased damage and has no cooldown when used from Stealth and for 6 sec after breaking Stealth.

name: Improved Poisons
description: Increases the application chance of your weapon poisons by 5%.

name: Improved Sprint
description: Reduces the cooldown of Sprint by 60 sec.

name: Improved Wound Poison
description: Wound Poison can now stack 2 additional times.

name: Inexorable March
description: You cannot be slowed below 70% of normal movement speed while your Fatebound Coin flips have an active streak of at least 2 flips matching the same face.

name: Inspiring Strike
description: Applying Envenom while Envenom is already active causes it to increase all damage you deal by 5% in addition to increasing your poison application chance.

name: Intent to Kill
description: Shadowstep's cooldown is reduced by 33% when used on a target afflicted by your Garrote.

name: Internal Bleeding
description: Kidney Shot and Rupture also apply Internal Bleeding, dealing up to 77 Bleed damage over 6 sec, based on combo points spent.

name: Iron Stomach
description: Increases the healing you receive from Crimson Vial, healing potions, and healthstones by 25%.

name: Iron Wire
description: Garrote silences the target for 5 sec when used from Stealth.\n\nEnemies silenced by Garrote deal 15% reduced damage for 5 sec.

name: Leeching Poison
description: Adds a Leeching effect to your Lethal poisons, granting you 3.0% Leech.

name: Lethal Dose
description: Your weapon poisons and Nature or Bleed damage over time abilities deal 1% increased damage to targets for each of your lethal poison or damage over time effects on them.

name: Lethality
description: Critical strike chance increased by 1%. Critical strike damage bonus of your attacks that generate combo points increased by 10%.

name: Lingering Darkness
description: After Deathmark expires, gain 30% increased Nature damage for 30 sec.

name: Lucky Coin
description: Every 7 coin flips, keep a lucky coin that bends you towards your fate for 12 sec. Your Agility is increased by 4%, the damage and bonuses of Fatebound Coins are increased by 50%, and coin flips are 15% more likely to match the same face as the last flip.\n\nCoin flips do not count toward finding a lucky coin while you have a lucky coin.

name: Mass Casualty
description: Deathstalker's Mark deals 40% of its normal damage to all other enemies within 8 yds that are afflicted by Rupture.

name: Master Poisoner
description: Increases the non-damaging effects of your weapon poisons by 20%.

name: Mean Streak
description: Fatebound Coins flipped by Envenom are 33% more likely to match the same face as the last flip.

name: Momentum of Despair
description: If you have critically struck with Fan of Knives, increase the critical strike chance of Fan of Knives and Crimson Tempest by 10% and critical strike damage by 20% for 8 sec.

name: Motivated Murderer
description: Increases your Energy regeneration by 20%.

name: Negotiable Contract
description: If the target of your Deathmark dies, Deathmark jumps to a nearby enemy combatant for its remaining duration.

name: Nimble Fingers
description: Energy cost of Feint and Crimson Vial reduced by 10.

name: Overflowing Purse
description: Envenom has a 15% chance to flip 3 Fatebound Coins.

name: Path of Blood
description: Increases maximum Energy by 50.

name: Poison Bomb
description: Envenom has a 5% chance per combo point spent to smash a vial of poison at the target's location, creating a pool of acidic death that deals 54 Nature damage over 2 sec to all enemies within it.

name: Poisoner's Drive
description: Applying Envenom while Envenom is already active restores 1 combo point.

name: Precise Killer
description: Critical strike damage bonus increased by 20%.

name: Quick Fingers
description: Increases your Agility by 3%.

name: Quietus Celeris
description: Deathstalker's Mark has a 30% chance to immediately consume a stack when applied.

name: Rapid Injection
description: Envenom's effect increases the damage of Envenom by 15%.

name: Ravenholdt Mint
description: Flipping Heads increases damage by an additional 4%. Damage dealt by flipping Tails is increased by 12%.

name: Razor Wire
description: Garrote lasts 6 sec longer.

name: Recuperator
description: Slice and Dice heals you for up to 1% of your maximum health per 3 sec.

name: Regicide's Reward
description: When Kingsbane ends, gain 2% haste for every 5 stacks of increased Kingsbane damage that you had, decreasing by 2% every 2 sec.

name: Rush to the Inevitable
description: Gain 5 Energy every time you flip a Fatebound Coin. Gain 15 Energy for Coins that land on their edge.

name: Sanguine Stratagem
description: Gain 1 additional max combo point.\n\nYour finishing moves that consume more than 5 combo points have increased effects, and your finishing moves deal 5% increased damage.

name: Sanguine Vial
description: When you deal the killing blow to a target that yields experience or honor, the cooldown of Crimson Vial is reduced by 15 sec and your next use heals 5% of your health instantly.

name: Scent of Blood
description: Each enemy afflicted by your Rupture increases your Agility by 2%, up to a maximum of 20%.

name: Seal Fate
description: Critical strikes with attacks that generate combo points grant an additional combo point per critical strike.

name: Secondary Poisoning
description: When you apply a Weapon Poison with a single-target attack, you have a 50% chance to strike a nearby enemy for 5 Physical damage and apply the same Weapon Poison to them.

name: Shadewalker
description: Each time you consume a stack of Deathstalker's Mark, reduce the cooldown of Shadowstep by 3 sec.

name: Shadowrunner
description: While Stealth or Shadow Dance is active, you move 20% faster.

name: Shroud of Night
description: Shroud of Concealment duration increased by 5 sec.

name: Shrouded Suffocation
description: Garrote damage increased by 20%. Garrote generates 2 additional combo points when used from Stealth.

name: Singular Focus
description: Damage dealt to targets other than your Marked target deals 5% Plague damage to your Marked target.

name: Sometimes Lucky
description: Critical strike chance increased by 3%.

name: Soothing Darkness
description: You are healed for 30% of your maximum health over 6 sec after activating Vanish.

name: Stillshroud
description: Shroud of Concealment has 50% reduced cooldown.

name: Subterfuge
description: Abilities requiring Stealth can be used for 3 sec after Stealth breaks.\n\nCombat benefits requiring Stealth persist for an additional 3 sec after Stealth breaks.

name: Sudden Demise
description: Bleed damage increased by 10%.\n\nTargets below 35% health instantly bleed out and take fatal damage when the remaining Bleed damage you would deal to them exceeds 150% of their remaining health.

name: Supercharger
description: Kingsbane supercharges 1 combo point.\n\nDamaging finishing moves consume a supercharged combo point to function as if they spent 2 additional combo points.

name: Superior Mixture
description: Crippling Poison reduces movement speed by an additional 10%.

name: Swift Slasher
description: Slice and Dice grants additional attack speed equal to 100% of your Haste.

name: Symbolic Victory
description: Shadow Dance additionally increases the damage of your next Eviscerate or Black Powder by 15%.

name: Systemic Failure
description: Garrote increases the damage of Ambush and Mutilate on the target by 30%.

name: Tempted Fate
description: You have a 30% chance to absorb 10% of any damage taken.

name: Thrill Seeking
description: Shadowstep has 1 additional charge.

name: Thrown Precision
description: Fan of Knives has 5% increased critical strike chance and its critical strikes always apply your weapon poisons.

name: Tight Spender
description: Energy cost of finishing moves reduced by 6%.

name: Toxic Stiletto
description: Shiv's Energy cost is reduced by 20, its cooldown is reduced by 15 sec, and its range is increased by 3 yds.

name: Unbreakable Stride
description: Reduces the duration of movement slowing effects 30%.

name: Unshakeable Drive
description: When you consume an application of Deathstalker's Mark, the damage of your next Ambush or Mutilate is increased by 50%.

name: Venomous Wounds
description: You regain 3 Energy each time your Garrote or Rupture deal Bleed damage to a target affected by your weapon poisons. Energy gain is reduced for bleeds beyond the first.\n\nIf an enemy dies while afflicted by your Rupture, you regain energy based on its remaining duration.

name: Vigor
description: Increases your maximum Energy by 50 and Energy regeneration by 5%.

name: Virulent Poisons
description: Increases the damage of your weapon poisons by 10%.

name: Without a Trace
description: Vanish has 1 additional charge.

name: Zoldyck Recipe
description: Your Bleed, weapon poison, and other Nature damage is increased by 15% against targets below 35% health.

name: Mark for Death
description: Move your active Deathstalker's Mark to your target.

name: Shadowstep
description: Step through the shadows to appear behind your target and gain 70% increased movement speed for 2 sec.
